$comment: Reward rates for RobinPumpNFTStaking, expressed in WHOLE reward tokens per day.
Solidity never sees these decimal strings: scripts/configure-tiers.ts converts each
value to base units using the LIVE decimals() value read from the reward token,
then passes integers to the contract. Do not introduce floating point on-chain.
Tier index order is fixed by the contract: 0..4 = Legendary..Common.
A rate of 0 is rejected by the contract (RewardRateNotSet).
